tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab 'gyur ro 'tshal bzhengs pa'i gsal byed sdeb sbyor gyi rgyan rnam par bkra ba zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab 'gyur ro 'tshal bzhengs pa'i gsal byed sdeb sbyor gyi rgyan rnam par bkra ba zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba'i bstan pa rab zab rgya mtsho'i rgyan// lhar bcas 'gro ba dpag yas nyer 'tsho'i rten// bsdus dngos rin chen bzhi yi mdangs bzang ba// dpal ldan bla ma lhun po rnam par rgyal// dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku yi dbang chen zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ri rgyal ngos zhal sgo yi nam mkha' la// sgrib pa'i sprin bral ljags kyi dbang po nyin mor byed pa brtse ba'i rlung gis kun tu bskyod pa las// gsung rab phreng ba gsung 'dzin padmo kun nas kha 'byed gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cus dam chos kyi// 'od zer zer ma phrom phrom 'phros pa khrag khrig 'khrigs pas srid gsum chos kyi snang bas 'gengs mdzad rgyal// mi dang lha min lha yi lhar gyur ston pas bstan pa'i bstan pa phun tshogs 'od zer gcig gis kyang*// blo gsal tshogs kyi blo yi rgya mtshor blo gros padma'i bslab gsum 'dab brgya rab tu rgyas mdzad cing*// legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i sbrang rtsi don gnyer gdul bya sbrang rtsi byed pa'i tshogs rnams nyin zhing legs bsdus nas// chos kyi kun dga'i dga' ston bkye bas kun nas dga' mdzad dam pa'i chos kyi nyin mor byed pa mchod// bde bar gshegs pas gsungs pa'i gsung rab bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i thos bsam bsam gtan ro 'dzin dbang po yis// legs par myangs pas myangs pa'i mthu yis mthu chen brnyes shing brnyes pa'i yon tan rnam pa sna tshogs phreng*// spel legs rin chen phreng ba lta bus bdag tu lta ba'i yid rab 'phrog pas rnam grol sku la brgyan// rgyal ba las 'khrungs rgyal sras rnams dang rang rgyal dgra las rnam rgyal 'phags pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig rdzi mi'i rtse mo cung zad bskyod pa'i 'od zer zer ma tsam zhig rab 'phros pas// skad cig cig la cig car nyid du bdud sde'i mun nag smag rum rab rib rab 'joms shing*// 'jig rten gsum du phan bde'i snang ba rnam pa sna tshogs rnam par 'phro ba'i 'od mdzad pa// 'gro ba'i mgon gyur 'jig rten mgon po sras dang bcas pas 'jig rten gsum po skyong gyur cig

/chos dbyings nam mkha'i dbyings las mkha' ltar ma g.yos shing*// sprul pa'i rnam 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs rnam 'phrul ba// rgyal yum de sras rgyal sras rnams kyi phrin las kyi// rnam 'phrul la brten rnam thar bsngags 'os bsngags par 'tshal// //'dir skye dgu rnams kyi dpal dang*/ 'byor pa dang*/ grags pa dang*/ mngon par mtho ba dang*/ nges par legs pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'i nor bu rin chen 'byung ba'i gzhi ni bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i chu gter nyid yin zhing*/ der skyes bu chen po'i ded dpon rnams tshul bzhin du zhugs pa dang 'jug pa rnams kyang skal ba phun sum tshogs pa yin la/ de dag ni snyan ngag mkhan rnams kyi yang dag gi dpal nyid du'ang 'gyur ro snyam du bsams nas smras pa/ tsha zer byed pa'i 'od zer gyis// rnam 'phrul chu skyes rgyas pa'i tshal// mthong na mthong ba tsam nyid kyis// dga' bar mi 'gyur su zhig yod// rgyal sras rgya mtshos bskor ba yi// rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams kyi zhing*// 'jig rten khams kyi rdul snyed du// bgrang ba las kyang 'das par 'tshal// de lta mod kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad gang chen mtsho yi phyag mthil na// 'jig rten bgrang yas rnam par brtsegs pa'i 'og nas bgrangs pa'i bcu gsum pa ni mi mjed de// de yi khyon ni gling bzhi ri rab nyi zlar bcas pa bye ba phrag brgya gnas pa yi// gling bzhi padmo bkram pa lta bur gnas pa rnams las gling 'di lho phyogs 'dzam bu'i gling*// de ltar gnas 'di nges byas nas// dus 'di yang ni nges par bgyi// bskal pa skad cig phreng ba ltar// dpag tu med pa rnams la yang*// 'jig rten snang mdzad 'jig rten mgon// kun tu rim bzhin byon pa las// bskal pa bzang po 'di la ni// gnyis kyis lhag pa'i rgyal ba stong*// 'gro ba skyob pa'i tshogs rnams byon// 'di ni bde gshegs bzhi pa ste// skye dgu'i tshe lo dpag med nas// brgya yi bar la mi dbang yang*// mang pos bkur ba nas bzung ste// zas gtsang bar du byon pa'i tshul// chu 'dzin tshogs las kha ba'i ri// kha ba'i ri las chu bo'i rgyun// chu bo'i rgyun las chu bo'i gter// chu gter che las rin chen bzhin// zas gtsang sras pos zag pa rnam spangs zag med bdud rtsi gsol ba las// zag med gzigs pas zag med sku brnyes gsung gi rnam 'phrul sna tshogs kyi// gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyis bsdus 'khor lo rim pa gsum bskor bas// 'jig rten gsum du 'jig rten mtha' dag chos kyi dga' bdes dga' bar mdzad// 'od zer brgya ba'i 'od zer gyis// chu skyes rgyas shing mun pa bsal// dngos rnams gsal byed gza' skar rnams// zil gyis gnon pa lta bur mchis// srid gsum 'gro ba kun gyi dpal// thub dbang bstan pa rin chen gter// lnga brgya phrag bcur gnas pa las// lnga brgya bdun pa'i dus kyi tshe// 'dzam gling byang phyogs sa yi char// bsod nams chen po'i chu gter las// jing gir gan zhes grags pa yi// sa 'dzin rin chen 'khrungs par gyur// de sras go gan rgyal po zhes// grags pa'i mi dbang gnyis pa yang*// mthu stobs nyi ma lta bu yi// gzhan sde'i mun pa rnam par bcom// de sras go yug gan zhes pa'ang*// srid la dbang ba'i rgyal por gyur// de yi yab mched go go gan// mthu yis rgyal srid rnam par bzung*// yid skyes kha lo sgyur ba yi// mi yi bdag po byung ba gyur// de gcung go pe la zhes pa// bsod nams nyi ma'i gzi brjid kyis// pha rol mun pa zil mnan nas// bka' yi rgyal srid skyong bar gyur// gtsug lag kun la thugs gsal zhing*// chos kyis rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong*// mthu yis sa la dbang sgyur ba// 'khor los sgyur rgyal lta bur gyur// rgyal dbang 'di yi gzi brjid phung po yis// gzi ldan gza' dbang dbang du bsdus byas nas// phyogs bcu rnams su gsung gi gsung zer ni// tsha zer zer ltar rnam par spros snyam byed// chos bzhin mdzad par gzhol ba yi// rgyal po de sras thu bo ni// jim gyim btsun mo go go can// jim gyim 'khor los sgyur sras bzhin// mtho ris yon tan dpal brnyes shing*// dad dang snying rjes brgyan pa'i thugs// chos kyi tshul la rab 'byor bas// kun tu grags pas khyab par gyur// 'di yi dpal 'byor grags pa mthu stobs ni// lha yi dbang po'i dpal 'byor ji bzhin te// rgyal ba'i gsung bzhin bsgrub pa'i rnam 'phrul yang*// rgyal sras rnams la 'gran pa lta bur snang*// yang na 'di yi dpal 'byor rin chen tshogs// klu yi dbang pos dga' mgur byin pa bzhin// bka' yi srid 'bangs kha lo sgyur ba ni// skye dgu'i bdag pos byin pa ji bzhin no// de ltar bsod nams ldan pa'i dpal// ma bsgrubs par yang rang nyid 'du// ma brtsad par yang dgra bo thul// ma bstod par yang ngang gis mtho// 'di ni spyod tshul tshul bzhin bsgrub pa dam pa'i rgyan gyis rab brgyan zhing*// dge ba bsgrub pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gnyen gyi mchog gis legs bzung nas// rgyal bas bsngags pa'i sngags kyi spyod tshul theg pa mchog la rab zhugs pas// kun tu rtogs pas kun nas brtags pa'i lta spyod rnams las rnam par grol// khyad par du yang khyad par 'phags pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten// bzhengs dang 'dri dang mchod dang rab gnas mchod bstod sogs// rgyal ba'i rigs bskrun bla ma'i gsung bzhin rgyal bas bsngags pa'i lam// bsgrub pa'i tshul la tshul gzhan dor nas tshul bzhin zhugs par gyur//

//khyad par du 'phags pa'i gdung rgyud chen por 'khrungs shing*/ ya rabs rnams la 'os pa'i 'jig rten gyi spyod tshul bzang pos rnam par brgyan pa'i sems dpa' chen po rnams ni/ mtsho skyes rnam par rgyas pa'i pad tshal chen por sbrang rtsi spyod pas mthong ba ltar skye bo thams cad kyi yid 'phrog par 'gyur zhing*/ thub pa'i dbang po'i gsung rab dang rjes su mthun pa'i bya ba bsgrub pa rnams ni snyan ngag mkhan rnams kyis bsngags par 'os pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ lha rnams kyis kyang gnam mkha' las a la la zhes shin tu dga' ba dang*/ spro ba'i sgra dbyangs kyis bstod de ched du brjod par 'gyur ro snyam du sems so// de bas na 'di'i rmad du byung ba'i bya ba yongs 'du'i me tog lta bu'i tshogs ni skye bo gzhan dang bar bya ba'i slad du yang ched du brjod par 'os so// zhes bsams te smras pa/ gzhan yang yab mes bla ma'i bka' drin bsam phyir dang*// rgyal srid dpal 'byor rgya cher rnam par rgyas phyir dang*// rang nyid mched bcas yum sras bde zhing byang chub phyir// chos kyi bya ba chos las 'byung ba 'di ltar bsgrubs// shing mo phag lo ston gyi zla ba la// nyid kyi chab srid smar khams tsom mdo ru// rgyal dang rgyal sras thams cad bskyed pa'i yum// gdul bya dag pa srid dang zhi ba yi// pha rol phyin byed pha rol phyin pa ni// rin chen gser sogs rin thang med pas bzhengs// de bzhin du yang me mo glang lo la// rgya che'i don ston sangs rgyas phal po che// rin chen mthing shog khyad par 'phags bskur nas// bzo gnas mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis sa skyar bzhengs// de yi de ltar yang nas yang du ni// dge dang dge 'bras spel phyir de de ltar// mdzad pas mdzad pa'i tshul la tshul bzhin du// dgongs pas dgongs pa 'phel nas yang 'di bzhengs// //rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rab mchog

/rdo rje theg pa rgya mtsho'i don// rgyud sde du ma'i rin chen rnams// gcig tu bsdus pa rgyud 'bum dang*// gsung rab rgya mtsho'i snying po mchog /rgyal ba sras bcas bskyed pa'i yum// 'gro ba'i bde legs mi zad gter// shes rab pha rol phyin ma gang*// stong phrag brgya par gsung pa gang*// stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa dang*// de bzhin stong phrag brgya pa dang*// khri pa dang ni khri brgyad stong*// yon tan rin chen sdud pa dang*// shes rab snying po la sogs pa// rgyal yum dbye ba med pa cig /thub pa'i gsung gcig gis gsungs kyang*// mos pa tha dad dbye ba yis// sde tshan mang du bzhugs pa dang*// rgyal dang rgyal sras phrin las dang*// zhing dang 'gro ba'i bkod pa sogs// rab 'byam rgya mtsho ston pa'i mdo// sangs rgyas phal po che dang ni// gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu rnams// khyad par rmad byung ston pa yi// rin chen spungs pa lta bu'i mdo// dkon mchog brtsegs par grags pa dang*// drang ba'i don dang nges don dang*// sde snod gsum dang bslab pa gsum// theg pa gsum gyi dbye ba yis// gsung pa'i mdo sde mang po dang*// bde gshegs bstan pa rin chen sgron// 'dzin pa shākya'i sras rnams kyi// spyod pa phun tshogs ston pa'i mdo// 'dul ba lung du grags pa ste// sdud pa po yis legs bsdus nas// lo paṇa rnams kyis legs bsgyur ba// 'gyur ro 'tshal du grags pa rnams// bde gshegs tsha zer rgyal po'i gsung zer lta bu'i 'od zer gyis// rnam par rgyal ba rgyal ba'i gsung rab pad tshal lta bu'i skyed mos tshal// bde legs dpal 'byor 'byor pa'i bdud rtsi sbrang rtsi lta bus rnam brgyan pa// gdul bya bung ba dga' ba'i dga' ston dga' mgur spyod pa bzhengs dgongs nas// bzhengs par byos zhes bka' lung stsal ba'i gsung*// gsung bzhin bsgrub pa'i skyes bu du ma yis// sa pho stag gi dbyar gyi dus bab tshe// rgya bod mtshams kyi chu ma mkhar zhes byar// mthing shog mthon mthing glegs bu lta bu'i gzhir// 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser mchog btso ma las// 'phrul yig yig mkhan da rigs la sogs kyis// gser phreng lta bur yid rab 'phrog pa bkod// sna tshogs bzo rig mkhas pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// dras dang glegs shing glegs thag na bza' sogs// 'gro ba'i yid 'phrog phul du byung ba yi// rnam par bkra ba phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub// dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bu yis// thub dbang gsung bzhin rab gnas legs bsgrubs pas// bde legs dpal 'byor lhag par 'phel ba'i gzhi// skye dgu rnams kyis mchod pa'i rten du gyur// khyad 'phags skyes bu du mas bsgrub bya ba// ngo mtshar skye bo kun gyi yid rab 'phrog

/'phags pa rnams kyi spyod pa'i rnam 'phrul yang*// 'jig rten gsum du 'gro ba'i yid 'phrog yin// tshul 'di tshul la mkhas pa'i tshul lta yi// snyan ngag mkhan gyi dpal gyis legs spel ba// snyan ngag gtsug lag tshul la mkhas rnams kyis// legs par gsan nas tshul bzhin brtag par mdzod// gser gyi yig phreng gis spras pa'i// mthing shog mthon ka chen po'i mdangs// gsal ba rnam gsal nyi ma yi// gzi brjid zil gyis gnon pa bzhin// yang na mthing shog mthing ga'i mdangs// nam mkha' dwangs pa'i kha dog bzhin// gser yig phreng du sbrengs pa ni// rgyu skar phreng du dngar ba bzhin// yang na rnam par gsal ba'i zhing*// baiḍūrya yi sa gzhi la// rnam 'phrul sna tshogs kun 'phrul ba'i// thub pa'i sprul sku bkram pa bzhin// gug skyed yan lag yi ge yi// rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa ni// lha dang 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// de yi rim gro bgyi pa bzhin// klog mkhan mkhas pas yi ge'i phreng*// klog pas klog gi sgra dbyangs ni// thub dbang yan lag drug cu yi// gsung gis gsung rab gsungs pa bzhin// klog skad rgyud mangs sgra dbyangs kyis// skye bo 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i yid// tshim zhing dang bar bgyis pa ni// chos kyi 'khor los gdul bya bzhin// glegs bam stobs bcu mnga' ba'i sku// mdzes pa de yi 'dzum pa'i mdangs// 'od zer bde bar gshegs pa'i 'od// glegs shing rnam bkra mtshan dpe'i rgyan// na bza' rnam par bkra ba yis// glegs bam rnam par brgyan pa gang*// snam sbyar snam phran glegs bu'i tshogs// bsgrigs pas thub sku brgyan pa bzhin// de ltar bsod nams 'bad rtsol legs par sbyor ba'i chu yi chu gter chen po las// mthing shog 'dab mar yig phreng me tog mdzes pa'i dri ldan phan bde'i grib bsil can// dpal 'byor phun tshogs 'bras bur bcas pa'i dpag bsam ljon shing rnam par rgyal ba gang*// lha dang lha min mi dang klur bcas ma lus 'gro ba'i 'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas 'di 'khrungs so// 'di tsam nyid du mtshar ba'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba// 'chi med yul du 'chi med bu mo mdzes ma rnams kyis// 'chi med dbang po dga' mgur mnyes par bgyi ba'i slad du// 'chi med yul gyi rol mo'i rnam 'phrul sna tshogs bgyi 'dra//

//'di ltar sems dpa' chen po 'di'i bya ba 'di tsam du ngo mtshar ba lha'i yul gyi dpag bsam gyi shing gi me tog rnams lha'i bu mo rnams kyis me tog phreng bar bsgrigs te nam mkha' las dpyangs pa'am/ klu'i yul gyi rin po che'i rigs rnam pa sna tshogs pa du ma rnams klu'i bu mo rnams kyis rin po che'i phreng bar bsgrigs te/ ri rab lhun po'i ngos las dpyangs pa ltar yid 'phrog pa ni shin tu yang bsngags par 'os la/ 'di'i 'bras bu yang khyad par du 'phags pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba smos ci dgos/ des na sems dpa' chen po 'di'i 'khor rnams kyang shin tu dga' ba 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' ba'i rigs so// snyam nas smras pa/ 'di yi snyan ngag mkhan rnams la// snyan ngag rgyan du gdams pa bzhin// snyan ngag mkhan po rnams kyis kyang*// lan du snyan ngag brjod pa bzhin// dge ba 'di dang dge gzhan 'dres pas bdag gzhan ma lus kun// kun tu kun dga'i gter la kun nas spyod tshul bzang po 'dis// 'di ltar tshul bzhin ston pa'i gsung rab zab mo'i chos// chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ba smos ci 'tshal// de ltar gsung rab rin chen gser gyis rab bzhengs nas// bklags dang mchod dang bstod pa'i dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan// ma lus blo yis gcig tu bsdoms nas rjes su yi rang gis// rnam spel dge ba'i rgyal sras jim gyim yab yum mched zlar bcas// btsun mo dam pa go go can dang sras kyi thu bo ni// ka ma la dang dharma pha la de bzhin da mur dang*// sras mo gu log gī ti zhes bya gzhan yang 'byon gyur pa'i// gdung rgyud 'khor dang rgyal srid bcas pa thams cad dus kun tu// chu bo'i rgyun ltar sku tshe ches cher ring ba dang*// lhun po'i ri ltar dpal 'byor ches cher mtho ba dang*// 'jig rten dbang ltar dbang phyug ches cher rgyas gyur cig

/skye ba skye bar rgyal ba rgya mtsho las// nyin re nyin rer dam chos legs nod cing*// gang dang gang du skyes pa thams cad du// dge dang dge ba'i dpal 'byor 'byor par shog /gzhan yang rang gzhan bde gshegs gsung*// gsung rab rgya mtsho 'gro ba'i bla// bla ma'i gsung bzhin bsgrubs pa'i mthus// mthu ldan stobs bcu brnyes par shog /de ltar gsung rab rgya mtsho rgya mtsho ltar// zab cing rgya che rgya cher legs gsungs pa// nye bar bzhengs tshul tshul bzhin brjod cig ces// lha des bskul nas bskul bzhin 'phags pas sbyar// //rgyal po chen po dbang phyug dam pa'i dpal gyis rnam par 'byor pa go pe la gan rgyal po zhes kun du grags pa'i sras kyi dam pa/ rgyal po jim gyim zhes bya bas/ gsung rab rin po che mtha' dag rin po che gser gyis bzhengs pa'i tshul/ tshul bzhin du brjod pa'i rab tu byed pa 'di ni dge slong 'phags pa zhes bya bas/ sa pho stag gi lo smin drug gi zla ba'i tshes lnga'i nyin par dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
